XY series · ROS

Roaring Skies

Released May 6, 2015 · 112 cards

Expanded

Roaring Skies is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on May 6, 2015. Its main set has 108 cards, plus 4 secret rares numbered beyond the set (112 in total). It includes 92 Pokémon, 19 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

42 illustrators worked on Roaring Skies. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (16), Ryo Ueda (6), Toyste Beach (6), Akira Komayama (5), Kagemaru Himeno (4), Megumi Mizutani (4), Ayaka Yoshida (3), Eske Yoshinob (3).
